protocol.evaluation: chronological holdout with rolling one-step-ahead inputs
protocol.feature_rule: Each prediction uses only the immediately preceding eight complete records.
protocol.test_input_rule: Earlier observed records in the test period may be used as history for later one-step-ahead predictions.
protocol.preprocessing_rule: Incomplete, non-numeric, non-finite, and out-of-range records are excluded; no values are imputed.
protocol.record_order: timestamp ascending, then SQLite record ID ascending

production_model.name: HistGradientBoostingRegressor
production_model.evaluation: Evaluated with the same chronological holdout as all baselines and candidates.

data_sufficiency.warning: Results are preliminary: the dataset or held-out sample is small. Collect more real observations before making a model-selection or improvement claim.
data_sufficiency.deep_learning_note: Transformer/TCN training is not included in this classical-model benchmark. The existing AI engine requires at least 50 complete records, and deep models should be evaluated only with a larger chronological training set.
